rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for something that looks old-fashioned, tacky, or unstylish.

example.english: The style of these trousers is really unfashionable.
example.traditional: 呢條褲個款真係好老土。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 fu3 go3 fun2 zan1 hai6 hou2 lou5 tou2

rows.note: Use this for a person, outfit, or style that is not trendy, especially in contemporary casual speech.

example.english: You always wear these clothes, so you look really unfashionable.
example.traditional: 你成日着呢啲衫，睇落真係唔潮。
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 zoek6 ni1 di1 saam1 tai2 lok6 zan1 hai6 m4 ciu4

rows.note: Use this when the style or design has gone out of date rather than simply looking uncool.

example.english: The design of this phone is unfashionable now, so the manufacturer should update it.
example.traditional: 呢部電話嘅設計已經過時，廠商應該更新吓。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 cit3 gai3 ji5 ging1 gwo3 si4 cong2 soeng1 jing1 goi1 gang1 san1 haa2
